description: Bytes an object made with Object.create(null) kept after a collection, its members set in order with the value 0, for members named by array indices (V8 keeps those as elements, not in the member table): a list of names, or count names 0, gap, 2 gap, .... Measured on Node v22.22.0 (V8 12.4.254.21-node.33), linux/x64, with --expose-gc; Node 20.20.0 and 21.7.3 (V8 11.3 and 11.8) measured within 1 percent of these for every store past 1 KB, and at most 12 percent above for an object of one member.
